snippet.title: Monroe Murders - Release Trailer 2025
snippet.description:
The first trailer for my upcoming Visual Novella, Monroe Murders. 

Monroe Murders is a decision-driven Visual Novella.  The story is broken into 10 chapters.  During each chapter, the player will engage with 1 or 2 characters and help them get to know each other better.  The choices you make will determine the overall outcome of the game.

In this story, you play as a barista, who begins to get too close to something more dangerous than they had bargained for when building an innocent love connection between two acquaintances leads you closer to uncovering the truth of the Monroe Murders. 

Play on Steam TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4043890/Monroe_Murders/


Releasing Fall of 2025.

http://www.monroemurders.com

Follow me on itch for updates as I approach release. 
https://palomino-blue.itch.io/monroe-murders
